import yfinance as yf
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import json

# Download data
tickers = ["BTC-USD", "CL=F", "TLT"]
start = "2015-01-01"
data = {}
for t in tickers:
    df = yf.download(t, start=start, auto_adjust=True, progress=False)
    data[t] = df

# Extract required series using squeeze to handle potential MultiIndex columns
btc_open = data["BTC-USD"]["Open"].squeeze()
btc_close = data["BTC-USD"]["Close"].squeeze()
cl_close = data["CL=F"]["Close"].squeeze()
tlt_close = data["TLT"]["Close"].squeeze()

# Align data on common dates (inner join)
df = pd.DataFrame({
    "BTC_Open": btc_open,
    "BTC_Close": btc_close,
    "CL_Close": cl_close,
    "TLT_Close": tlt_close
}).dropna()

# Calculate indicators
df["TLT_SMA_20"] = df["TLT_Close"].rolling(window=20).mean()

# Generate signals on Close of day T (no look-ahead)
df["entry_sig"] = (df["CL_Close"] >= 110) & (df["TLT_Close"] < df["TLT_SMA_20"])
df["exit_sig"] = (df["CL_Close"] < 105) | (df["TLT_Close"] > df["TLT_SMA_20"])

# Shift signals to execute at next-day Open (day T+1)
df["entry_sig_lag"] = df["entry_sig"].shift(1).fillna(False)
df["exit_sig_lag"] = df["exit_sig"].shift(1).fillna(False)

# Position state machine: 0 = flat, -1 = short
position = 0
positions = []
n_trades = 0

for i in range(len(df)):
    e = df["entry_sig_lag"].iloc[i]
    x = df["exit_sig_lag"].iloc[i]
    
    if position == 0 and e:
        position = -1
        n_trades += 1
    elif position == -1 and x:
        position = 0
    positions.append(position)

df["position"] = positions

# Daily returns
# Strategy: Short BTC from Open to Close -> Return = -(Close - Open) / Open
df["btc_oc_ret"] = (df["BTC_Close"] - df["BTC_Open"]) / df["BTC_Open"]
df["strat_ret"] = -df["position"] * df["btc_oc_ret"]

# Buy & Hold: Close-to-Close
df["bh_ret"] = df["BTC_Close"].pct_change()

# Performance metrics
strat_eq = (1 + df["strat_ret"]).cumprod()
bh_eq = (1 + df["bh_ret"]).cumprod()

total_return = float(strat_eq.iloc[-1] - 1)
buy_and_hold_return = float(bh_eq.iloc[-1] - 1)

# Sharpe Ratio (annualized, risk-free=0)
mean_ret = df["strat_ret"].mean()
std_ret = df["strat_ret"].std()
sharpe = float(mean_ret / std_ret * np.sqrt(252)) if std_ret != 0 else 0.0

# Max Drawdown
peak = strat_eq.cummax()
drawdown = (strat_eq - peak) / peak
max_drawdown = float(drawdown.min())

result = {
    "total_return": total_return,
    "buy_and_hold_return": buy_and_hold_return,
    "sharpe": sharpe,
    "max_drawdown": max_drawdown,
    "n_trades": n_trades
}

print("RESULT", json.dumps(result))
